cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from lib import *

c = itertools.count()
def s(sid, off, h, fin=False): return F("STREAM", id=sid, offset=off, data_hex=h, fin=fin)
def r(sid, size): return F("RESET_STREAM", id=sid, final_size=size)
def C(off, h): return F("CRYPTO", offset=off, data_hex=h)
def P(): return F("PING")
def PAD(): return F("PADDING")
def UNK(): return F("UNKNOWN")
def HD(): return F("HANDSHAKE_DONE")
def CL(app, code): return F("CLOSE", app=app, code=code)
def ACK(rng): return F("ACK", ranges=rng)
def d(p, t): return dg(t, 1200, [p])
def p(*frames, level="A", pn=None, auth=True): return pkt(level, next(c) if pn is None else pn, list(frames), auth)
def K(t,lvl,act): return key(t,lvl,act)
def oneA(events, **kw): return one([K(0,"A","install")] + events, **kw)

# CLOSE
v = view(oneA([d(p(s(0,0,"6162"), CL(True, 7)),1), d(p(P()),2)]))
print("c1 app close", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["st"], v["rt"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(CL(False, 3), s(0,0,"61")),1)]))
print("c2 close first", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["st"], v["rt"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(s(0,0,"61"), CL(False, 3), s(4,0,"ff",True)),1)]))
print("c3 later frames ignored semantically", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["st"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(s(0,0,"61"), CL(False, 3), UNK()),1)]))
print("c4 later frames preflighted", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(s(0,0,"61"), CL(False, 3), HD()),1)]))
print("c5 hd later", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(s(0,0,"6162",True), CL(True, 1)),1)]))
print("c6 fin err then close", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(s(0,0,"61"), r(0,1)),1)]))
print("c7 err no close", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["st"], v["rt"])
# CLOSE at I level (app=false allowed)
v = view(one([d(p(CL(False, 0x12), level="I", pn=0),1), d(p(P(), level="I", pn=1),2)]))
print("c8 close at I", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(one([d(p(CL(True, 0x12), level="I", pn=0),1)]))
print("c9 app close at I", v["pk"], v["conn"])
# pending dropped on close
v = view(oneA([d(p(C(0,"aa"), level="H", pn=0),1), d(p(s(0,0,"61"), CL(True, 4)),2), d(p(C(1,"bb"), level="H", pn=1),3)]))
print("c10 pending after close", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["cr"])
# error rolls back crypto bytes and stream state within the packet
v = view(oneA([d(p(C(0,"aabb"), s(0,0,"61"), C(4,"cc"), r(0,1)),1)]))
print("c11 rollback", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["cr"], v["st"], v["rt"])
# idle timer
v = view(oneA([d(p(P()),5)], idle_ms=10))
print("i1", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(P()),5), K(20,"A","install")], idle_ms=10))
print("i2", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(P()),5), {"t":14,"op":"tick"}, {"t":15,"op":"tick"}], idle_ms=10))
print("i3", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(P()),5)], idle_ms=0))
print("i4 disabled", v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(P(), auth=False),5), {"t":15,"op":"tick"}], idle_ms=10))
print("i5 unauth no activity", v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d(p(ACK([[0,3]]), pn=0),5), {"t":14,"op":"tick"}], idle_ms=10, sent={"I":[],"H":[],"A":[[0,3]]}))
print("i6 ack accepted activity", v["pk"], v["conn"])
# queued/duplicate/error do not update activity
v = view(oneA([d(p(P(), level="H", pn=0),1), K(5,"A","install"), d(p(P(), level="A", pn=0),6), d(p(P(), level="A", pn=0),16), {"t":20,"op":"tick"}], idle_ms=10))
print("i7", v["pk"], v["conn"])
# terminated: key/tick effects ignored
v = view(oneA([d(p(CL(True,1)),5), K(6,"H","install"), K(7,"I","discard"), {"t":9,"op":"tick"}], idle_ms=2))
print("i8", v["keys"], v["conn"], v["pk"])
EOF
